openQuestions: Localhost-only /n4x-host is intentional but is not a security boundary once /mcp is reachable.
N4X_SYSTEM_RELEASE_INDEX is empty in local compose; Host only compares an official index when that env is set.

notes.responsibility: Process supervisor, reverse proxy, install file lock, official zip import, materialize from graph, localhost /n4x-host, dump/restore, optional release-index compare. Never imports System Python. First boot imports and enables the official zip when no SystemRevision is active. CLI/MCP import does not enable.
notes.cli: n4x serve, n4x mcp-stdio, n4x host import|enable|dump|restore, n4x package stage|fetch, n4x login|logout.
notes.health: /health is served by Host, not proxied to the worker.
notes.officialArchive: N4X_OFFICIAL_SYSTEM_ARCHIVE or /opt/n4x/cache/official-system.zip. Docker bakes the zip; the Host image does not copy backend/n4x/system.
notes.dump: Stops the worker, packs runtime plus Neo4j dump via N4X_NEO4J_DUMP_COMMAND, then restarts.
